verdict.rationale: Choosing a storage region is a fair question for a SaaS error-monitoring platform like Raygun, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions data regions, residency options or region selection. The documented privacy controls (client-side filtering of sensitive data, disabling IP address storage) are adjacent features and do not let users choose where data is stored.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
